info.description: The Funds Confirmation Consent Management API allows users to revoke specific funds confirmation consents using a unique identifier. This operation is essential for managing customer permissions, ensuring compliance with financial regulations, and enhancing customer data management practices. Typically utilized by financial institutions and payment service providers, this API allows them to efficiently control consent lifecycles while maintaining transparency and trust with their customers. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline the consent revocation process within their applications.

delete.description: This operation allows users to delete a specific funds confirmation consent identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure that the resource ID is correct before performing this operation as it will permanently remove the consent from the system.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a funds confirmation consent with the specified identifier. This operation is intended to remove previously granted consent for funds confirmation, ensuring that no further checks or actions are taken regarding the consented account.

204.description: Request completed successfully; the resource has been deleted.
